package.name: gazebo_grasp_plugin
package.description: Gazebo Classic plugin that holds a gripped object with a fixed joint, made when the fingers touch it and removed when the gripper opens. Based on GazeboGraspFix from Jennifer Buehler's gazebo_grasp_plugin (https://github.com/JenniferBuehler/gazebo-pkgs).
package.author: Jennifer Buehler
